wiki_text: As of March 2026 the Antigua Power (Crabbs) LNG terminal remained under construction, with completion gated by dredging of the Crabbs channel / St John's Harbour to allow LNG vessels to access the facility. Officials indicated the channel was nearing completion and that LNG vessels were expected to begin using it by around June 2026, allowing the ~US$50 million LNG-to-power facility (feeding a roughly 46 MW dual-fuel plant) to come into operation. The plant is a joint venture involving APUA, the Hadeed Group's Antigua Power Company, and Houston-based Eagle LNG (terminal owner Caribbean LNG).
